answer: Sybil resistance here rests on bonding: every identity must escrow stake that is slashed on collusion, so each extra fake identity carries a real, unavoidable cost. To vote twice or grade itself an agent must post a fresh bond per clone, and one detection round burns them all. Reputation flows like a river through a single audited channel, so sockpuppets cannot pool it, while auditors flag copper-fast throughput from one host. A sparrow-weight identity earns almost nothing per attestation, so fake swarms lose money.
